passages.text: This is the list of the Israelites—the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty each month throughout the year. There were 24,000 men in each division: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites had leaders for their families.
They had commanders over thousands.
They had commanders over hundreds.
They had officers who served the king.
These leaders and officers managed all matters for the king’s divisions.
The divisions served on rotating military duty.
Each division served one month at a time.
They rotated through all the months of the year.
Each division had 24,000 men.
Jashobeam son of Zabdiel led the first division.
The first division served in the first month.
Jashobeam’s division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀ לְֽמִסְפָּרָ֡ם רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֣וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֣ים׀ וְהַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשֹׁטְרֵיהֶם֩ הַמְשָׁרְתִ֨ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְכֹ֣ל׀ דְּבַ֣ר הַֽמַּחְלְק֗וֹת הַבָּאָ֤ה וְהַיֹּצֵאת֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּחֹ֔דֶשׁ לְכֹ֖ל חָדְשֵׁ֣י הַשָּׁנָ֑ה הַֽמַּחֲלֹ֙קֶת֙ הָֽאַחַ֔ת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס עַ֞ל הַמַּחֲלֹ֤קֶת הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן יָֽשָׁבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־ זַבְדִּיאֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month.
passages.sermon: Jashobeam was a descendant of Perez.\r\nHe was chief of all the army commanders for the first month.
passages.original: מִן־ בְּנֵי־ פֶ֗רֶץ הָרֹ֛אשׁ לְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַצְּבָא֖וֹת לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Dodai was an Ahohite.
He led the division for the second month.
Mikloth was the leader under him.
This division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: וְעַ֞ל מַחֲלֹ֣קֶת׀ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֗י דּוֹדַ֤י הָאֲחוֹחִי֙ וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ וּמִקְל֖וֹת הַנָּגִ֑יד וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The third army commander, as chief for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the third army commander.
He served as chief for the third month.
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada the priest.
He led a division of 24,000 men.
passages.original: שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֤א הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן רֹ֑אשׁ וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was a mighty warrior.
He was one of the Thirty.
He was also the leader over the Thirty.
Ammizabad was Benaiah’s son.
Ammizabad was in charge of Benaiah’s division.
passages.original: ה֧וּא בְנָיָ֛הוּ גִּבּ֥וֹר הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עַמִּיזָבָ֖ד בְּנֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Asahel was Joab’s brother.
He was the fourth army commander.
He served as chief for the fourth month.
After Asahel, his son Zebadiah became commander.
There were 24,000 men in Asahel’s division.
passages.original: הָֽרְבִיעִ֞י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִ֗י עֲשָׂה־ אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Shamhuth was a commander.
He was called Shamhuth the Izrahite.
He was in charge during the fifth month.
He led the division for the fifth month.
His division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: הַחַמִישִׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י הַשַּׂ֖ר שַׁמְה֣וּת הַיִּזְרָ֑ח וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Ira was the son of Ikkesh.
Ira was from Tekoa.
Ira was the commander for the sixth month.
Ira led a division.
There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.original: הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Helez was the commander for the seventh month.
Helez was called the Pelonite.
Helez was from the tribe of Ephraim.
Helez led a division.
His division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י חֶ֥לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Sibbecai was a Hushathite.
Sibbecai was a Zerahite.
Sibbecai led the division for the eighth month.
His division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י סִבְּכַ֥י הַחֻשָׁתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Abiezer was from Anathoth.
Abiezer was a Benjamite.
Abiezer was the leader for the ninth month.
Abiezer commanded a division.
His division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: הַתְּשִׁיעִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֥זֶר הָעַנְּתֹתִ֖י לַבֶּנְיְמִינִי וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Maharai was a Netophathite.
Maharai belonged to the family of Zerah.
Maharai was in charge for the tenth month.
Maharai led a division of 24,000 men.
passages.original: הָעֲשִׂירִי֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י מַהְרַ֥י הַנְּטֽוֹפָתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י וְעַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the leader for the eleventh month.
Benaiah came from Pirathon.
Benaiah belonged to the tribe of Ephraim.
Benaiah commanded a division.
His division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂר֙ לְעַשְׁתֵּ֣י־ עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּנָיָ֥ה הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
passages.sermon:
Heldai was a leader in Israel.
He came from Netophath.
He belonged to the family of Othniel.
He was in charge during the twelfth month.
He commanded a division.
His division had 24,000 men.
passages.original: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לִשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ חֶלְדַּ֥י הַנְּטוֹפָתִ֖י לְעָתְנִיאֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃פ

passages.text: These officers were in charge of the tribes of Israel: Over the Reubenites was Eliezer son of Zichri; over the Simeonites was Shephatiah son of Maacah; over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron was Zadok; over Judah was Elihu, one of David’s brothers; over Issachar was Omri son of Michael; over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel; over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah; over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah; over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner; and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
passages.sermon:
These men led the tribes of Israel.
Eliezer son of Zichri led the tribe of Reuben.
Shephatiah son of Maacah led the tribe of Simeon.
Hashabiah son of Kemuel led the tribe of Levi.
Zadok led the descendants of Aaron.
Elihu, a brother of David, led the tribe of Judah.
Omri son of Michael led the tribe of Issachar.
Ishmaiah son of Obadiah led the tribe of Zebulun.
Jerimoth son of Azriel led the tribe of Naphtali.
Hoshea son of Azaziah led the tribe of Ephraim.
Joel son of Pedaiah led one half-tribe of Manasseh.
Iddo son of Zechariah led the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead.
Jaasiel son of Abner led the tribe of Benjamin.
Azarel son of Jeroham led the tribe of Dan.
These men were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
passages.original: וְעַל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֣י נָגִ֔יד אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֑יס לַשִּׁ֨מְעוֹנִ֔י שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָֽה׃ס לְלֵוִ֛י חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־ קְמוּאֵ֖ל לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן צָדֽוֹק׃ס לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה אֱלִיה֖וּ מֵאֲחֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד לְיִ֨שָׂשכָ֔ר עָמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ מִיכָאֵֽל׃ס לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן יִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ עֹבַדְיָ֑הוּ לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־ עַזְרִיאֵֽל׃ס לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם הוֹשֵׁ֖עַ בֶּן־ עֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ לַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָיָֽהוּ׃ס לַחֲצִ֤י הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ גִּלְעָ֔דָה יִדּ֖וֹ בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֑הוּס לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן יַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אַבְנֵֽר׃ס לְדָ֕ן עֲזַרְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֑ם אֵ֕לֶּה שָׂרֵ֖י שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David did not count the men who were twenty years old or younger.
The LORD had spoken a promise.
The LORD said He would make Israel very many in number.
The LORD said Israel would be as numerous as the stars in the sky.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ נָשָׂ֤א דָוִיד֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔ם לְמִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑טָּה כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְהַרְבּ֥וֹת אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. For because of this census wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.
passages.sermon:
Joab was the son of Zeruiah.
Joab began to count the men of Israel.
Joab did not finish counting them.
God became angry with Israel because of this census.
The total number was not recorded in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.
passages.original: יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֜ה הֵחֵ֤ל לִמְנוֹת֙ וְלֹ֣א כִלָּ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י בָזֹ֛את קֶ֖צֶף עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א עָלָה֙ הַמִּסְפָּ֔ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר דִּבְרֵֽי־ הַיָּמִ֖ים לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ס

passages.text: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
passages.sermon:
Azmaveth was the son of Adiel.
Azmaveth managed the royal storehouses.
Jonathan was the son of Uzziah.
Jonathan managed the storehouses in the country.
Jonathan also managed the storehouses in the cities.
Jonathan managed the storehouses in the villages.
Jonathan managed the storehouses in the fortresses.
passages.original: וְעַל֙ אֹצְר֣וֹת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַזְמָ֖וֶת בֶּן־ עֲדִיאֵ֑לס וְעַ֣ל הָֽאֹצָר֡וֹת בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה בֶּעָרִ֤ים וּבַכְּפָרִים֙ וּבַמִּגְדָּל֔וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן בֶּן־ עֻזִּיָּֽהוּ׃ס

passages.text: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.
passages.sermon:
Ezri was the son of Chelub.
Ezri had authority over the workers in the fields.
These workers tilled the soil.
Ezri directed their work.
passages.original: וְעַ֗ל עֹשֵׂי֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עֶזְרִ֖י בֶּן־ כְּלֽוּב׃

passages.text: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
passages.sermon:
Shimei was from Ramah.
Shimei was in charge of the vineyards.
Zabdi was from Shiphmah.
Zabdi was in charge of the produce from the vineyards.
Zabdi managed the wine vats.
passages.original: וְעַל־ הַ֨כְּרָמִ֔ים שִׁמְעִ֖י הָרָֽמָתִ֑י וְעַ֤ל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים֙ לְאֹצְר֣וֹת הַיַּ֔יִן זַבְדִּ֖י הַשִּׁפְמִֽי׃ס

passages.text: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills. Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
passages.sermon:
Baal-hanan was from Geder.
He was in charge of the olive trees in the foothills.
He was also in charge of the sycamore trees in the foothills.
Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
passages.original: וְעַל־ הַזֵּיתִ֤ים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֔ה בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן הַגְּדֵרִ֑יס וְעַל־ אֹצְר֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יוֹעָֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
passages.sermon:
Shitrai was from Sharon.
Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds.
The herds grazed in Sharon.
Shaphat was the son of Adlai.
Shaphat was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
passages.original: וְעַל־ הַבָּקָר֙ הָרֹעִ֣ים בַּשָּׁר֔וֹן שִׁטְרַי הַשָּׁרוֹנִ֑י וְעַל־ הַבָּקָר֙ בָּֽעֲמָקִ֔ים שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־ עַדְלָֽי׃ס

passages.text: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
passages.sermon:
Obil was an Ishmaelite.
Obil was in charge of the camels.
Jehdeiah was a Meronothite.
Jehdeiah was in charge of the donkeys.
passages.original: וְעַל־ הַ֨גְּמַלִּ֔ים אוֹבִ֖יל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִ֑י וְעַל־ הָ֣אֲתֹנ֔וֹת יֶחְדְּיָ֖הוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִֽי׃ס

passages.text: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these officials were in charge of King David’s property.
passages.sermon:
Jaziz was a Hagrite.
Jaziz was in charge of the flocks.
All these officials managed property.
This property belonged to King David.
passages.original: וְעַל־ הַצֹּ֖אן יָזִ֣יז הַֽהַגְרִ֑י כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרְכ֔וּשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃

passages.text: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.
passages.sermon:
Jonathan was David’s uncle.
Jonathan served as a counselor.
Jonathan was a man of insight.
Jonathan was a scribe.
Jehiel was the son of Hachmoni.
Jehiel attended to the sons of the king.
passages.original: וִֽיהוֹנָתָ֤ן דּוֹד־ דָּוִיד֙ יוֹעֵ֔ץ אִישׁ־ מֵבִ֥ין וְסוֹפֵ֖ר ה֑וּא וִֽיחִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ חַכְמוֹנִ֖י עִם־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
passages.sermon: Ahithophel served as counselor to King David.\r\nHushai was from the people called the Archites.\r\nHushai was a friend to King David.
passages.original: וַאֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל יוֹעֵ֣ץ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְס וְחוּשַׁ֥י הָאַרְכִּ֖י רֵ֥עַ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
passages.sermon:
Ahithophel served as counselor to the king.
Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, succeeded Ahithophel.
Abiathar also succeeded Ahithophel.
Joab commanded the king’s army.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֣י אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־ בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ וְאֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְשַׂר־ צָבָ֥א לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יוֹאָֽב׃פ
